items.name: Total company backlog, Q2 2026
items.claim: Boeing's total company backlog grew to a record $715 billion, including over 6,200 commercial airplanes.
items.source_excerpt: Total company backlog grew to a record $715 billion, including over 6,200 commercial airplanes

items.name: Defense, Space & Security segment backlog, Q2 2026
items.claim: Boeing's Defense, Space & Security segment backlog was $85 billion, with 27 percent representing orders from customers outside the U.S.
items.source_excerpt: Backlog at Defense, Space & Security was $85 billion, with 27 percent representing orders from customers outside the U.S.

notes: Both items sourced from the stored Q2 2026 8-K earnings exhibit (data/edgar/docs/BA.json). Defense, Space & Security is the munitions-relevant segment (it discloses Milestone C on MQ-25A Stingray and low-rate initial production of T-7A Red Hawk in the same release, though without dollar figures attached to those individually).
